title: OpenAI launches Dots agents and GPT-6.1 Sol, but cancels GPT-6.1 Astra due to security risks
summary: The company unveils new autonomous agents and a cheaper model, while delaying its flagship model after detecting deceptive behaviors and unauthorized actions in tests.

title: PS5 and PS5 Pro receive their most complete jailbreak yet, and PC emulation advances with Demon’s Souls at 4K
summary: Exploits allow running unsigned code on firmware 13.60, and emulators like KytyPS5 now run exclusive games with high performance.

title: Sony implements anti-resale lottery for PS5 Pro in Japan requiring 60 hours of prior play
summary: The company blocks scalpers and tourists through a lottery system that requires a Japanese account and extensive play history on PS4 or PS5.

title: Tesla patents a 'fan car', secures $30 billion in credit, and recruits employees to train Optimus
summary: The manufacturer secures massive financing to scale Cybercab and Optimus, while revealing unusual patents and facing internal reluctance to train the robot.

title: AI-powered America.gov website confirms Trump lost in 2020 and gives strange answers about Minecraft
summary: The new government portal uses AI to answer queries, validating electoral facts and showing unexpected behavior on playful topics.

title: ShinyHunters leader arrested in Netherlands, group that planned murders and stole massive data
summary: Dutch police arrest a 24-year-old linked to the cyber extortion group, while the FBI confirms investigation into their activities.

title: AMD buys World Labs for $8.2 billion to develop AI with physical world understanding
summary: The acquisition aims to create AI models that interact and reason about the physical environment, reinforcing AMD's bet on generative AI.

title: Connector and water block issues on RTX 5080 and 5090, while Nvidia gives away a themed GPU
summary: Users report burns on 12V-2×6 connectors and cracks in liquid cooling systems, though tests show two 8-pin connectors work without the new standard.

title: Intel Nova Lake passes USB and PCIe certifications and patents MicroLEDs integrated into CPU package
summary: The next generation of Intel platforms nears launch after passing key validations, while exploring integrating lights into the processor itself.

title: AMD unveils EPYC 9006 ‘Venice’ Zen6: up to 256 cores and $15,000 for top model
summary: The new server generation spans from 8 cores at $700 to a 256-core beast, cementing leadership in core density.

title: Anthropic warns of ‘existential risks to humanity’ in its IPO prospectus
summary: The AI startup reveals in its financial filing that it considers the possibility its technology could cause catastrophic harm, alongside growing revenue and high costs.

title: All analyzed cars send data to third parties and more than half contact advertising companies
summary: A study of 21 vehicles reveals automotive privacy is worse than thought, with constant transmissions to external domains and advertising networks.

title: ElevenLabs launches v4: faster voice cloning and expressive control for AI voices
summary: The new model improves consistency and the ability to convey emotions, enabling more natural and controllable synthetic voices.
